h1:
Where to Stay in Phichit?
11 Real-Reviewed Hotels
For Every Budget
heroSub: 11 Phichit hotels picked across every price level — a Lanna-Balinese boutique resort near Bueng Si Fai down to city hotels from THB 350, covering Phichit town, Taphan Hin and Wachirabarami. Prices from THB 350–900/night.
introH2: 🏙️ Why location matters most when picking a Phichit hotel
introHtml: Phichit is a small, quiet province and its hotels spread across three main zones — Phichit town around Saraluang and Sri Mala roads, walkable and close to markets; the Tha Luang / Bueng Si Fai side, quieter with garden-style resorts; and Taphan Hin district, a secondary town near the train station and the Nan River. Many travellers book without checking which district they're in and end up driving further than expected. This guide rounds up 11 Phichit hotels picked across every level — from a Lanna-Balinese boutique resort to budget city hotels — each backed by real guest reviews, with prices compared on 3 sites and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Phichit has no public transport within the town — driving or renting a car is easiest. The northern railway line (Bangkok–Chiang Mai) stops at both Phichit town and Taphan Hin. Stay zones in this guide: Phichit town — Saraluang and Sri Mala roads, near markets and Bueng Si Fai · Tha Luang / Bueng Si Fai side — quieter garden resorts · Taphan Hin district — near the train station and the Nan River · Wachirabarami district — on Route 115, handy for a roadside stopover.

entries.name: Fahluang Residence
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Luang · near Bueng Si Fai
entries.storyHtml: Fahluang Residence earns the highest score in this guide at 8.6 from 29 reviews. It's a city hotel on the Tha Luang side near Bueng Si Fai, with rooms around 24 sqm — many freshly decorated — and breakfast bundled into the starting rate, which is rare at this price. It sits quieter than the town centre but is only a few minutes' drive from the markets and the lake.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If two of you want a sitting area, compare the 48 sqm Classic VIP — on weekdays it's often not far off the smaller rooms.
pros: Highest review score in the group, 8.6 from 29 reviews
Breakfast included in the starting rate — rare at this price
Near Bueng Si Fai, quieter than the town centre
Many rooms freshly decorated and well kept
cons: On the Tha Luang side, not by the central market — you'll drive
Popular rooms are limited; book ahead on weekends

entries.name: Lanna Bali Kumnuntuo
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kamnan Tao · Phichit outskirts · near Bueng Si Fai
entries.addr: 99 Moo 4, Tha Luang, Mueang Phichit (Kamnan Tao area)
entries.storyHtml: Lanna Bali Kumnuntuo is the most-reviewed stay in this guide — 164 reviews, score 8.5. It's a boutique resort blending Lanna and Balinese styling in the Kamnan Tao area on Phichit's outskirts, near Bueng Si Fai. Guests single out the garden setting and the decor that sets it apart from a standard town hotel — a good pick if you want a resort feel without a high price. Every room is a garden-view Deluxe.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Holiday and festival rates jump noticeably, so if your dates are flexible a weekday gets you the starting rate and more availability.
pros: Most reviewed in the group, 164 reviews, score 8.5
Lanna-Balinese theme — a change from town hotels
A 4-star resort feel at a modest starting rate
Near Bueng Si Fai, good for a relaxed stay
cons: On the outskirts (Kamnan Tao) — you'll drive into town
Holiday and festival rates rise clearly

entries.name: The Nest Hotel Phichit
entries.storyHtml: The Nest Hotel is the second most-reviewed stay in the group — 46 reviews, score 8.4. It sits on Saraluang Road in the town centre right next to a 7-Eleven, so grabbing essentials is easy. Standard rooms start with breakfast for two, and there's a Suite if you want a separate lounge — a solid pick if you want to stay central and get around on foot.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're here for errands in town or to connect by train, this Saraluang Road spot walks to restaurants and the market more easily than the outskirts.
pros: Second most reviewed in the group, 46 reviews
Central Saraluang Road location, next to 7-Eleven
Standard rooms include breakfast for two
Suite available for more space
cons: On a town road — street-side rooms can catch traffic noise
It's a city hotel, no garden resort feel

entries.name: Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin
entries.addr: 57 Chomtireevet Road, Taphan Hin Subdistrict, Taphan Hin District
entries.storyHtml: Roseinn Hotel is the pick in Taphan Hin district, near the train station, score 8.3. It suits travellers arriving by rail or with errands on the Taphan Hin side — Phichit's other secondary town. Every room has a balcony, rates start at just THB 450, and there are Studio and Suite options when you want more space.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Arriving on the northern line and getting off at Taphan Hin? This is closer to the station than connecting onward into Phichit town, saving travel time.
pros: Near Taphan Hin train station, easy access
Starting rate of just THB 450, good value
Every room has a balcony; Studio and Suite available
Ideal for errands or stays on the Taphan Hin side
cons: In Taphan Hin district, not Phichit town
A small hotel with few reviews so far (15)

entries.name: Ruen Rim Nan Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Huai Ket · Taphan Hin · on the Nan River
entries.addr: 48 Rim Nan Road, Huai Ket Subdistrict, Taphan Hin District
entries.storyHtml: Ruen Rim Nan Resort is a riverside resort on the Nan River in Taphan Hin district, score 8.3. The draw is the quiet riverside setting and the wooden houses that work well for groups or families. It's an option for travellers who want a riverside getaway feel rather than a town stay — reviews are still few, but the score sits in good territory.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a group or family? The riverside wooden house often works out cheaper per head than booking several in-building rooms, and you get the full river setting.
pros: Riverside Nan River location, quiet setting
Wooden riverside houses, good for groups/families
Solid review score of 8.3
A relaxing alternative to town hotels
cons: In Taphan Hin district, far from Phichit town
Few reviews so far (8), limited guest feedback

entries.name: Modern Resort Phichit
entries.storyHtml: Modern Resort is a resort-style stay in Phichit town on the Khlong Khachen side, on a main road, score 8.2. Rooms are decorated in a newer style with both twin and king options, plus parking — handy if you're driving in. The main-road location makes getting in and out of town easy; reviews are still few but the score is good.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Rates climb during festivals and busy dates, so booking a weekday in advance gets you the better starting rate.
pros: Newer-style decorated rooms, score 8.2
On a main road, easy in and out of town
Has parking — handy if you drive
Mid-range starting rate that's accessible
cons: Few reviews so far (10)
Rates rise clearly during busy periods

entries.name: Orchid Place Hotel
entries.addr: 24/115 Sraluang Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phichit District
entries.storyHtml: Orchid Place Hotel is a budget city hotel in central Phichit on Sraluang Road, score 8.0 from 28 reviews. From just THB 540 you get a room with air-con, fridge, TV and a coffee set, with a Deluxe on offer if you want more space. The central location keeps restaurants and the market within walking distance — a good pick for budget travellers who want to stay in town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: On a budget but want a bit more room? Compare Superior and Deluxe — a few hundred baht difference buys clearly more space.
pros: Low starting rate of THB 540 in the town centre
On Sraluang Road, walk to restaurants and the market
Rooms include a coffee set; Deluxe available
Good for budget travellers who want to be central
cons: A budget hotel with basic facilities
Standard rooms are compact — check the room type first

entries.name: SP Resort and Garden
entries.storyHtml: SP Resort and Garden has the lowest starting rate in this guide — semi-detached houses from THB 437, score 8.0. It sits on Route 115 in Wachirabarami district, handy as a roadside stopover or for travellers who want a private house with its own kitchen. There are both semi-detached and detached houses, plus monthly rentals for longer stays or work in Phichit.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Staying several days or working in the area? Ask the property directly about the monthly rate — it's usually much cheaper than booking nightly.
pros: Lowest starting rate in the guide, THB 437
Private houses with their own kitchen, fridge, sofa
Monthly rentals available for long stays / work
On Route 115, handy for a roadside stopover
cons: In Wachirabarami district, far from Phichit town
A roadside stay with a simple, no-frills feel

entries.name: Bed Hub Hotel Phichit
entries.storyHtml: Bed Hub Hotel is a budget hotel on the Khlong Khachen side of Phichit town, score 8.0. What guests note is the spacious rooms and big beds from THB 550 — good value for a 2-star. It goes up to a Deluxe, and some rooms have a garden-view balcony, making it a fit for budget travellers who still want a room that isn't cramped.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Want a garden-view balcony and more space? Compare Superior with Standard — roughly THB 150 more for added room and a view.
pros: Spacious rooms with big beds from THB 550
Goes up to a Deluxe (largest room)
Some rooms have a garden-view balcony
Good value for a budget-tier hotel
cons: A 2-star hotel with basic facilities
Few reviews so far (12)

entries.name: Phichit Plaza Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Saraluang Rd · opposite Sri Suk Hospital
entries.addr: 9 Saraluang Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phichit District
entries.storyHtml: Phichit Plaza Hotel is a city hotel on Saraluang Road, opposite Sri Suk Hospital, score 7.6. It's a tall building where upper-floor rooms get city views, and it runs from Superior up to a Deluxe Family that takes an extra bed. The central location suits anyone here for hospital errands or who wants to be near the market.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a family? The Deluxe Family takes an extra bed and works out better than two rooms — and ask for an upper floor for a more open view.
pros: Central location, opposite Sri Suk Hospital
Tall building — upper-floor rooms get city views
Deluxe Family room for families
Walk to the market and town restaurants
cons: Lower review score than the top group (7.6)
An older building — room condition varies

entries.name: Oka Nakorn Hotel
entries.addr: 2/91 Sri Mala Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phichit
entries.storyHtml: Oka Nakorn Hotel has the lowest starting rate in this guide — from THB 350, on Sri Mala Road in Phichit town. It's a simple stay for budget travellers who just need a night's sleep or are in town for errands. The score and review count are low (6.6 from 4 reviews), so it's worth checking the room condition and recent photos before booking.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The THB 350 Standard is for a no-frills overnight. For a room in better shape and a bit more space, step up to an upper-floor Superior, which guests say is in better condition.
pros: Lowest starting rate in the guide, THB 350
In-town location on Sri Mala Road, near the market
Has parking — handy if you drive
Fits budget travellers needing a one-night stay
cons: Lowest score in the group (6.6) and very few reviews (4)
An older property — check room condition and recent photos first

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Phichit hotel for you

advice.head: On a budget, want the cheapest
advice.bodyHtml: → Oka Nakorn Hotel THB 350 in town on Sri Mala Road · or SP Resort and Garden THB 437, a private house with kitchen on Route 115 in Wachirabarami

advice.head: Want the best review scores
advice.bodyHtml: → Fahluang Residence THB 580, score 8.6, near Bueng Si Fai with breakfast · or Lanna Bali Kumnuntuo THB 800, most reviewed with 164 reviews

advice.head: Want to stay in central Phichit town
advice.bodyHtml: → The Nest Hotel Phichit THB 650 on Saraluang Road, next to 7-Eleven · or Orchid Place Hotel THB 540, a budget option in town

advice.head: Want a relaxed resort feel
advice.bodyHtml: → Lanna Bali Kumnuntuo THB 800, a Lanna-Balinese boutique near Bueng Si Fai · or Ruen Rim Nan Resort THB 900 on the Nan River in Taphan Hin

advice.head: Travelling by train / Taphan Hin side
advice.bodyHtml: → Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin THB 450 near Taphan Hin station · or Ruen Rim Nan Resort THB 900 on the Nan River in Taphan Hin district

advice.head: Travelling as a family / with kids
advice.bodyHtml: → Phichit Plaza Hotel THB 650 with a Deluxe Family room that takes an extra bed · or Ruen Rim Nan Resort THB 900, riverside wooden houses for groups

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and can change by date and season. Check live prices and compare 3 sites before every booking · During festivals and long weekends, rates rise and rooms sell out quickly, so book ahead · Phichit has no in-town public transport — driving or renting a car is easiest, with train stations at both Phichit town and Taphan Hin · Article by ThailandAddict
faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Phichit hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which zone should I stay in for a Phichit trip?
faq.a: It depends on what you're here for · Phichit town (Saraluang and Sri Mala roads) suits being near the markets, restaurants and Bueng Si Fai (The Nest, Orchid Place, Phichit Plaza, Oka Nakorn) · the Tha Luang / Bueng Si Fai side is quieter with garden resorts (Fahluang Residence, Lanna Bali) · Taphan Hin district suits train travellers or a riverside stay on the Nan River (Roseinn, Ruen Rim Nan)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Phichit hotels cost?
faq.a: Phichit is a small province, so room rates aren't high · City and budget hotels start around THB 350–650 a night · Mid-range hotels and resorts run around THB 650–900 · Boutique resorts and riverside wooden houses run around THB 800–1,500 · Rates during festivals and long weekends can be higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Does Phichit have in-town public transport, and how do I get around?
faq.a: Phichit town has no scheduled public transport · The easiest way around is to drive or rent a car · The northern railway line (Bangkok–Chiang Mai) stops at both Phichit town and Taphan Hin, and many hotels in this guide have parking

faq.q: ❓ Where can I stay near Bueng Si Fai?
faq.a: Bueng Si Fai is Phichit's landmark lake · Hotels on the Tha Luang side are closest, such as Fahluang Residence (THB 580, breakfast included) and Lanna Bali Kumnuntuo (THB 800, a Lanna-Balinese boutique) · Both are quieter than the town centre and only a few minutes' drive from the lake

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Phichit hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion period, so open and compare all 3 before every booking — each review page in this guide has the comparison links · Some small Phichit hotels may not appear on every site, and a few need a direct phone booking

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay for errands on the Taphan Hin side?
faq.a: Taphan Hin is Phichit's other secondary town, a fair drive from the main town · If you're here for errands or arriving by train on this side, staying in Taphan Hin itself saves time — for example Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin (THB 450, near the train station) or Ruen Rim Nan Resort (THB 900, on the Nan River)
